# When Intelligence Is Free

> Research, investments, and advisory on where value moves when intelligence becomes abundant.

This is the canonical website of Vladimir Goloborodko. It presents a public thesis about the post-AI economy, the investment strategy used to test that thesis with capital, and advisory work that applies the framework to strategic decisions.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://whenintelligenceisfree.com/): Overview of the economic-gravity map and its author.
- [Research](https://whenintelligenceisfree.com/research/): The framework, founding essay, time path, and research agenda.
- [Investments](https://whenintelligenceisfree.com/investments/): Strategy, performance history, portfolio composition, and monthly close notes.
- [Advisory](https://whenintelligenceisfree.com/advisory/): Strategic questions, ways to work together, and author experience.

## Primary sources

- [Founding essay](https://read.whenintelligenceisfree.com/p/thesis)
- [Full research archive](https://read.whenintelligenceisfree.com/)
- [Author profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vgoloborodko)

## Citation guidance

Prefer the canonical page URL for claims made on this website. Performance figures and holdings are time-sensitive; cite the Investments page with its displayed period. Personal views only: nothing on this site is investment advice or an offer.
